FACT_ID: sec14-R01 | anchor: A01
During a tire blowout, hold the wheel firmly and avoid slamming on the brakes. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0122]

FACT_ID: sec14-R02 | anchor: A01
After a blowout, keep the vehicle controlled as it slows, then brake gently and stop in a safe place. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0122]

FACT_ID: sec14-R03 | anchor: A01
If the accelerator sticks, keep watching the road and shift into neutral. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0122]

FACT_ID: sec14-R04 | anchor: A01
Do not engage a steering-lock mechanism while trying to stop a vehicle with a stuck accelerator. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0122]

FACT_ID: sec14-R05 | anchor: A01
If the service brakes fail, avoid suddenly applying the parking brake because this can cause loss of control. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0122]

FACT_ID: sec14-R06 | anchor: A01
A vehicle without working brakes must not be driven further; call for assistance. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0122]

FACT_ID: sec14-R07 | anchor: A01
Steam from under the hood can indicate overheating; stop safely and switch off the engine. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0122]

FACT_ID: sec14-R08 | anchor: A01
Do not open a hot radiator cap; allow the engine to cool. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0122]

FACT_ID: sec14-R09 | anchor: A01
If smoke comes from under the hood, leave traffic, stop, shut off the engine and get occupants away from the vehicle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0122]

FACT_ID: sec14-R10 | anchor: A01
Do not attempt to fight a large vehicle fire; obtain assistance. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0122]

FACT_ID: sec14-R11 | anchor: A02
A vehicle battery can release explosive fumes, so do not smoke or use a flame nearby. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0123]

FACT_ID: sec14-R12 | anchor: A02
At the first sign of a breakdown, ease off the accelerator and move smoothly toward a safe roadside location. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0123]

FACT_ID: sec14-R13 | anchor: A02
Signal intentions and check traffic carefully when moving a failing vehicle out of its lane. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0123]

FACT_ID: sec14-R14 | anchor: A02
Once safely stopped, make the vehicle visible with hazard lamps or reflective warning equipment. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0123]

FACT_ID: sec14-R15 | anchor: A02
Do not stand immediately behind or alongside a broken-down vehicle exposed to traffic. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0123]

FACT_ID: sec14-R16 | anchor: A02
If the disabled vehicle remains in the traffic lane, wait away from it while help is sought. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0123]

FACT_ID: sec14-R17 | anchor: A02
When the vehicle is safely clear of traffic, the guide recommends waiting inside with doors locked and calling for help. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0123]

FACT_ID: sec14-R18 | anchor: A02
Do not try to wave passing vehicles down for assistance. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0123]

FACT_ID: sec14-R19 | anchor: A03
Carbon monoxide from vehicle exhaust has no smell and can affect occupants without an obvious odor warning. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0124]

FACT_ID: sec14-R20 | anchor: A03
A leaking exhaust or an engine running in a confined garage can permit carbon monoxide to accumulate. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0124]

FACT_ID: sec14-R21 | anchor: A03
The guide directs a person suspecting exhaust-gas poisoning to get fresh air immediately. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0124]

FACT_ID: sec14-R22 | anchor: A03
Do not attempt to drive through a flooded roadway; turn back and select another route. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0124]

FACT_ID: sec14-R23 | anchor: A03
Floodwater can hide a damaged or washed-out road even when the water looks shallow. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0124]

FACT_ID: sec14-R24 | anchor: A03
If no alternate route is available, wait on higher ground for floodwater to recede. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0124]

FACT_ID: sec14-R25 | anchor: A03
If a vehicle enters water, the guide directs occupants to begin escaping immediately instead of waiting inside. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0124]

FACT_ID: sec14-R26 | anchor: A04
The guide’s water-escape cue POGO means releasing belts, opening windows and getting out. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0125]

FACT_ID: sec14-R27 | anchor: A04
After a collision involving injury, death or damage, stop when safe and identify yourself rather than leaving the scene. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0125]

FACT_ID: sec14-R28 | anchor: A04
Request police assistance after a collision and an ambulance when needed. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0125]

FACT_ID: sec14-R29 | anchor: A04
Collect involved persons’ names and witness details after a crash. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0125]

FACT_ID: sec14-R30 | anchor: A04
Drivers must exchange their name, address and vehicle identification details and show a license when requested. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0125]

FACT_ID: sec14-R31 | anchor: A04
If an unattended vehicle or property is damaged, notify police, seek the owner and leave identifying contact information. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0125]

FACT_ID: sec14-R32 | anchor: A04
Document travel direction, lane, occupants, date, time and weather after a crash. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0125]

FACT_ID: sec14-R33 | anchor: A04
Notify the insurer as soon as practical after a collision. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0125]

FACT_ID: sec14-R34 | anchor: A05
Do not move an injured person unless an immediate life-threatening danger requires it. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0126]

FACT_ID: sec14-R35 | anchor: A05
Before leaving a vehicle unattended, stop the engine, secure the ignition, remove the key and apply the brake. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0126]

FACT_ID: sec14-R36 | anchor: A05
For an approaching authorized emergency vehicle using warning signals, yield, move toward the right edge and stop until it passes. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0126]

FACT_ID: sec14-R37 | anchor: A05
On a multilane road near a stopped emergency vehicle, change into a nonadjacent lane only when that can be done safely. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0126]

FACT_ID: sec14-R38 | anchor: A05
If moving over is unsafe or impossible, slow to a reasonably safe speed for the conditions. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0126]
